title: SimXAI: A Simple Drop-in Layer Increases Interaction Quality and Understanding in Conversational XAI
abstract: arXiv:2610.41856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational explainable AI (ConvXAI) agents often use GUS-style architectures with separate modules for intent recognition, dialogue management, and template-based response generation. While faithful to the underlying XAI methods, these pipelines are hard to adapt and often struggle with context-dependent follow-up questions. We present SimXAI, a lightweight LLM-centric conversational layer that replaces these modules with a single tool-calling LLM that bridges access to existing XAI resources. Rather than a standalone agent, SimXAI serves as a modular interface that enables conversational access to external XAI resources. We further introduce an evaluation suite for single- and multi-turn parsing, faithfulness, and contextualization. Across existing and new datasets, SimXAI achieves strong function-selection accuracy and high faithfulness while better handling context-dependent requests. translated_title: SimXAI：一个简单的即插即用层提升对话式可解释AI的交互质量与理解
translated_abstract: 对话式可解释AI（ConvXAI）智能体通常采用GUS风格的架构，其中包含用于意图识别、对话管理和基于模板的响应生成的独立模块。虽然这些流水线忠实于底层的XAI方法，但它们难以适配，并且在处理依赖上下文的后续问题时常常表现不佳。我们提出了SimXAI，一个轻量级的以大语言模型（LLM）为中心的对话层，它用一个单一的工具调用型LLM取代了这些模块，从而桥接对现有XAI资源的访问。SimXAI并非一个独立的智能体，而是作为一个模块化接口，实现对外部XAI资源的对话式访问。我们进一步引入了一个评估套件，涵盖单轮和多轮解析、忠实性以及上下文关联能力。在现有和新的数据集上，SimXAI实现了强大的函数选择准确性和高忠实性，同时能更好地处理依赖上下文的请求。在一项仅替换对话层的用户研究中（原文在此处截断）...
tldr: SimXAI用一个简单的即插即用LLM对话层替代传统ConvXAI中分离的意图识别、对话管理和模板生成模块，在保持高忠实性的同时更好地处理依赖上下文的后续问题。
en_tdlr: SimXAI is a simple drop-in LLM-based conversational layer that replaces separate intent recognition, dialogue management, and template modules in ConvXAI systems, achieving strong function-selection accuracy and high faithfulness while better handling context-dependent follow-up questions.
